title: Electrophysiologic Study Versus Electrocardiographic Monitoring (ESVEM)
brief_summary: To determine whether electrophysiologic study (EPS) or Holter monitoring (HM) was the better method for selecting effective long-term antiarrhythmic drug therapy in patients with sustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, or an episode of aborted sudden death.
raw_criteria: Men and women with documented ventricular tachycardia and those resuscitated from sudden death.
